title: Logistics
description: [Nova-Addon] Cables, Power Cells, Item Storage and more
body:
### Dependencies
Requires [Nova](https://modrinth.com/plugin/nova-framework) ([Installation Guide](https://docs.xenondevs.xyz/nova/admin/setup/)) and [Simple Upgrades](https://modrinth.com/plugin/nova-simple-upgrades).

# Logistics
![An image of the blocks from Logistics](https://i.imgur.com/Pkgv9Vg.png)
![Cables: Cables will help you connect everything. They can transfer power, items and fluids. You're also able to set an item filter.](https://i.imgur.com/KLehUOZ.png)
![Item Storage: The Storage Unit allows you to store an infinite amount of items in a single block!](https://i.imgur.com/PUFjRQq.png)
![Vacuum Chest: The Vacuum Chest collects all nearby items. You can also set an Item Filter that prevents unwanted items from being collected.](https://i.imgur.com/28TeQ8Y.png)

... and much more!
